== Notes ==
* Part of the [[Keiran Thackeray (disguise)]] replacement skillbar.
* This skill will also affect White Mantle, while they are temporarily allied for dialogue.
* Because this is a Ranger skill, its energy cost is reduced by [[Expertise]].
* If you have a mini pet active the video effect can be seen on the mini as if it were being healed too.
